Enrich a corpus frame with the scalar curation signals.

Source: R/curation_records.R
curation_enrich_records.Rd

config is the only source of topic and keyword policy. Existing derived keyword columns are removed before scoring, so re-enriching a frame with a new configuration cannot retain a previous lexicon's totals. Raw sidecar scores for the configured topic names are reused; this function does not invoke an embedding or classifier backend.

Usage

curation_enrich_records(
  records,
  config,
  drop_list_columns = TRUE,
  preserve_scored_features = FALSE
)

Arguments

records

A data frame with non-empty country and document_id columns. It may contain planscanR list columns such as attachment_urls and download_status.

config

A planscanR_curation_config supplying topics and lexicon.

drop_list_columns

If TRUE, remove UI-unfriendly attachment, download, discovery, and local-path list columns after deriving counts.

preserve_scored_features

If TRUE, require the configured scored feature columns before enrichment and restore their exact values, including NA, after enrichment. This is the opt-in path for a verified scored-input context; the default retains ordinary keyword recomputation.

Value

The enriched input frame with cosine_max, keyword scores, attachment/download counts, and classifier fallback columns.
